title: Mercury hero
description: Full-bleed misty dawn valley with a centred, medium-weight 65px headline and a soft sub line. An email field shaped as a frosted pill holds the periwinkle button; a frosted second pill sits beside it, and a small dark disclaimer bar rests at the bottom.
notes: pass your own photo through backdrop; the default is CSS/SVG art drawn from theme colours
made to sit under mercury-header with overlay on
name: mercury-hero
